facts.business: Regency Ceramics Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of ceramic products with plants in Yanam (Puducherry) and Vemavaram Village, Bapatla District, Andhra Pradesh.

auditor.name: M/s. K S Rao & Co., Chartered Accountants, Hyderabad
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: 1) Financial statements prepared without considering impairment of Property, Plant and Equipment; 2) Non-provision of liability towards salary, wages, gratuity and leave encashment for factory employees since lock-out from 31.01.2012; 3) Inability to obtain confirmations for Debtors, Creditors, Loans and Advances; 4) Long pending Trade Receivables and advances of Rs.2,419.65 Lakhs with expired limitation period; 5) Long pending Trade payables of Rs.2,320.49 lakhs; 6) Non-provision of interest on unsecured loans from Directors and Body Corporates and overdue MSME dues; 7) Non-provision of interest and penalties on old statutory dues; 8) Unable to comment on accuracy of inventory valuation. Material uncertainty relating to going concern due to erosion of net worth.

key_risks: Erosion of net worth and material uncertainty relating to going concern
Lock-out of factory since 31.01.2012 with non-provision of employee liabilities
Long pending receivables (Rs.2,419.65 Lakhs) and payables (Rs.2,320.49 lakhs) with expired limitation periods
Non-provision for impairment of Property, Plant and Equipment
Non-provision of interest on unsecured loans and statutory dues
Inability to obtain confirmations from debtors, creditors, loans and advances
facts.related_party_note: No related party transactions reported in Form AOC-2 for FY 2025-26. Both non-arm's length and material arm's length transactions are disclosed as NIL.
